text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: Dedicated pool 'delta-east-2' reporting sustained elevated 5xx rate for tenant 'orchid-corp' (VPC). Paging #infra-oncall.
oncall-ashwin: Ack. Investigating now. @dana-eng can you pull scheduler/pod logs and surface any noisy tenants?
dana-eng: Looking at recent logs — seeing KV cache pressure + long-tail latency spikes. Top processes show a sustained tensor-serving spike from orchid-worker-3. No clear OOMs yet.
sam-sre: Recommend isolating tenant to a temporary pool and scaling delta-east-2 by +2 GPUs while we assess. Initiating isolation in 1m.
ops-bot: Runbook step -> tenant isolation command: ```
redwoodctl pool isolate --tenant orchid-corp --from-pool delta-east-2 --to-pool delta-temp-1
redwoodctl pool scale --pool delta-east-2 --add-gpus 2
```
oncall-ashwin: Executing isolation now. Will monitor error-rate and p99 latency. @liaison-jackie please prepare an initial customer-facing note (brief).
liaison-jackie: On it. Draft: "We're investigating elevated 5xx from your dedicated pool. We're isolating traffic and scaling capacity — no data loss expected. Will update in 30m." Do we want to pre-offer credits if impact >60m? :thinking: 
maya-prod: Metrics update: isolation started T+2m, 5xx rate dropping 4.2% -> 0.6%. p99 latency trending down. KV cache warming happening as expected.
sam-sre: Good signal. No evidence of data corruption. Plan: keep isolated for 45m, then stepwise reintroduce. Recommend post-incident comms + bespoke credit: suggest 10% usage credit for impacted window + exec summary.
liaison-jackie: I'll include that offer in the comms as authorized by SRE lead. Also requesting customer 1:1 technical debrief — should we propose tomorrow EOD?
oncall-ashwin: Yes, schedule debrief with account exec. Also create an RCA draft and link here (internal path): /incidents/6201234567-rca-draft.md. Tagging @trevor-eng for kernel/scheduler follow-up.
trevor-eng: I'll dig into kernel scheduling and model-variant fallback logs. Initial hypothesis: quantized execution path hit a memory-pressure fallback causing heavy CPU stalls on that tenant's worker. Adding logs to RCA.
ops-bot: Incident status update: Mitigated via tenant isolation + scale. Severity lowered to SEV3. Actions: RCA draft, customer comm, credit plan, postmortem. :white_check_mark:
liaison-jackie: Sending the "we're investigating" -> "mitigated" update to Orchid CSM + engineering contact now. Draft (internal) posted: "We isolated your tenant and scaled capacity; services restored; offering credits; technical debrief scheduled."
oncall-ashwin: Thanks all. Handing off monitoring to @sam-sre for overnight watch. I'll own the RCA timeline and exec summary. If anything flares up, re-page infra-oncall.
